name: Alice
source:
Alice specializes in Elemental magic. She enjoys lazing around on the Academy's grounds, soaking in the sun and nature, and pulls Sophie along whenever she has a chance.

She openly dislikes Lyra, who was Sophie's mentor during 1st year. It's rumored that Alice doesn't study at all, due to the many 1st year courses she is retaking.
